title: HybriSeq: probe-based device-free single-cell RNA profiling
boundary: Adjacent RNA-targeted split DNA probes are joined by SplintR, then receive two split-pool ligation barcodes and a third PCR barcode. Direct RNA-splinted reporter ligation differs from HyPR HCR-hairpin/readout recruitment and QBC RT-copy tagging; not merely another target panel.
evidence_scope: Published2025 primary publisher identity and indexed Results/Fig1 preparation overview verified; primaryPMC12365068 overview corroborates demonstrated NGS. Direct publisher page redirected to identity endpoint. Full Methods/SI and actual oligos not read; no curation/count.

title: Simultaneous profiling of chromatin-associated RNA at targeted DNA loci and RNA-RNA Interactions through TaDRIM-seq
boundary: Protein-G-Tn5 targets selected DNA elements and in-situ proximity ligation recovers associated RNA together with RNA-RNA contacts in intact nuclei. Target-tethered tag installation plus joint contact-library capture is a physical preparation boundary beyond routine capture-panel or contact-analysis substitution.
evidence_scope: Published2025 NatureCommunications16:1500 exact identity/primary abstract verified (DOI contains2024). Primary indexed overview describes actual wet steps; direct article open redirected to identity endpoint. Full chemistry/supplement and predecessor comparison remain pending.

title: SCOPE-Seq: a scalable technology for linking live cell imaging and single-cell RNA sequencing
boundary: Drop-seq-derived capture beads receive optical barcode oligos by split-pool ligation; bead-free sonication/library sequencing supplies an optical-to-sequence lookup. Microwell live imaging, on-bead RNA capture and reversible hybridization decoding preserve phenotype linkage physically, not by image-alignment software alone.
evidence_scope: Published24December2018 primary identity/abstract and bead-preparation/Fig1 overview verified, PubMed30583733. Later SCOPE-seq2(10.1038/s41598-020-76599-w) identity/overview inspected as successor: redesigned shared optical/sequence bead barcode, not counted as an additional lead here; exact version/component selection required later. No full curation.

title: Multiplexed optical barcoding and sequencing for spatial omics
boundary: A pool of splints joins letter oligos to cDNA; photocleavable spacers expose a fresh5prime phosphate for iterative ROI-specific letter ligation. Demonstrated RT/cDNA sequencing and arbitrary letter transitions distinguish this single-strand splint scheme from BALI staggered duplex overhang barcoding; compare exact substrates before registration.
evidence_scope: Published18March2026, versionofrecord4May2026 primary identity/Results light-controlled-barcode and demonstrated spatial-transcriptome overview verified; primaryPMC13136315 confirms same published work. Direct publisher open identity-gated. Reference/article-in-press PDF is superseded, not another source version to merge. No Methods/SI curation.

title: Joint single-cell measurements of nuclear proteins and RNA in vivo
boundary: Isolated nuclei undergo RNA-compatible FA-NT fixation/permeabilization and DNA-antibody intranuclear staining with optimized blocking before joint nucleus-hash/ADT/transcript capture. Actual intranuclear epitope preservation/access plus library capture differs from simply swapping surface CITE antibodies or gene panels.
evidence_scope: Published4October2021 primary exact identity/abstract and indexed primaryPMC8532076 selected nuclear-staining preparation excerpt verified; PubMed34608310 confirms DOI/year. DirectPMC open gated. Broad chemistry and downstream actual library recipe not curated; no facts borrowed from held INs-seq lead.

title: GLASS-seq: a gel-anchored, ligation-assisted, scalable biosensing platform for low-cost regional spatial transcriptomics
boundary: SplintR joins target-specific split probes; acrylamide-tagged anchors reversibly immobilize reporter products in polyacrylamide during staining and ROI dissection, then PCR appends spatialX/Y indexes. Gel-retained reporter intermediates are a physical chemistry boundary beyond HybriSeq probe ligation or merely different ROI dimensions.
evidence_scope: Published online29June2026 verified by primaryPubMed42379044 (issue1November2026 is later than this discoverydate). Exact primary publisher identity/abstract prep overview available indexed; direct publisher403. Full Methods/SI, anchoring/release chemistry and oligos remain unread. No performance guarantees adopted.

title: Large-scale, spatially resolved panoramic CRISPR screening in native tissue environments using Perturb-DBiT
boundary: Direct-capture and polyadenylation-capture branches co-barcoded guideRNA and totalRNA; PAC installs polyA in situ before RT and orthogonal spatial ligations. Added RNA substrate processing and guide/total-RNA co-library preparation distinguish it from only increasing a CRISPR panel in original polyA-DBiT.
evidence_scope: Published11June2026 primary exact identity/abstract and selected PAC preparation overview verified in accessible publisher article (in-situEcoliPAP thenRT before barcodeA/B). No full sourcepass or branch-equivalence assumption; exact DC/PAC construction must remain separate at curation.

title: Mapping the physical network of cellular interactions
boundary: Mild dissociation retains interacting cell structures; visual selection and micromanipulation separate their component cells into associated single-cell RNA libraries, with an alternative preserved-multiplet branch. Actual cell/sample provenance is retained through physical isolation, distinct from computationally inferring contacts between independent transcriptomes.
evidence_scope: Published21May2018 primary publisher identity/abstract plus author-hosted finalPDF preparation overview/Fig5flow inspected (https://www.hubrecht.eu/app/uploads/2017/11/NATURE_METHODS2018.pdf). No full Methods/SI or claim all recovered contacts pre-existed dissociation; direct downstream constructor and branch selection require curation.
